sourceLimits: One currently selected individual V2 original-project portrait is the internal authority, not an external franchise reference.
Only visible garment, drone and equipment surfaces are qualified; tiny medical engravings, hidden coat geometry and reverse mechanisms remain interpreted. No perfect1:1 certification.
No chronological age is asserted. Every scene is family-safe, non-romantic and modest.
Neon Requiem settings are new compatible cyberpunk medical/rescue compositions; they are not official screenshots.
The old purple short-jacket unarmed atlas was personally opened and is historical only; it does not qualify the source long yellow medical coat or drones.
